description: Motor Vehicle Hospitalizations by Road User Type is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. The number of Motor Vehicle hospitalizations of greater than 24-hours in British Columbia by road user role type. This data is based on all hospital admissions and includes crashes on roads where the Motor Vehicle Act does not apply (such as forest-service roads, industrial roads and private driveways). Coverage: Government of British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. Its tags are hospital, motor vehicle, Translation of hospital, Translation of motor vehicle. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-04-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
